# Design System

Use `visual-design-system` and `design-handoff`.

Proceed only after `APPROVE VISUAL DIRECTION v1` and `APPROVE WIREFRAMES v1` (or owner-approved equivalents).

Deliver semantic color/type/spacing/radius/elevation/motion/layout tokens, initial component inventory, anatomy/variants/states, theme strategy, icon rules, accessibility checks and token-to-CSS variable plan. Evaluate existing UI dependencies before proposing additions. Do not implement components or add packages.

Update `docs/design/04-DESIGN-SYSTEM.md`. Include sample token definitions and rationale. Request `APPROVE DESIGN SYSTEM v1`.
